name: catalyst_capability_baseline_contract_v1
principle: Each declared capability has exactly one task-matched authoritative external baseline. Internal Catalyst models are safety floors or ablations only and can never substitute for that external baseline. A stronger paper-only method is tracked separately until it is reproducible; metrics may never be cherry-picked across baselines.

global_rules.goal: Match or exceed the unique authoritative baseline contract-by-contract; obtain independently confirmed >5 percentage-point gains on several predeclared primary Top-K directions without hiding hard-slice regressions.

sequence_reaction_bidirectional.paper: TIGER: Text-Informed Generalized Enzyme-Reaction Retrieval, ACL 2026 / arXiv:2605.24489
sequence_reaction_bidirectional.reason: TIGER directly targets bidirectional enzyme-reaction retrieval and reports stronger ReactZyme results, but no official executable implementation was located in the paper/arXiv code links as of 2026-09-01. Track it as a literature frontier until reproducible; never mix its metrics with EnzGFM.
sequence_reaction_bidirectional.upgrade_rule: If an official implementation becomes available, or a clean independent reproduction is frozen and validated without target-label tuning, upgrade the whole affected contract to TIGER before new comparison; never mix TIGER and EnzGFM metric-by-metric.

r2e_structure_available.scenario: enzyme structure or author-supported pocket inputs available
r2e_structure_available.support_scope: Exact common author-supported Enzyme-405 reconstruction support; current direct local evidence is 99 valid reaction groups from the deterministic 100-reaction reconstruction.
allowed_adaptation: deterministic support intersection required by author inputs
metric wrapper over retained author predictions

unsupported_baseline_metrics.MRR: N/A: raw EnzymeCAGE prediction rows are not retained
unsupported_baseline_metrics.MAP: N/A: raw EnzymeCAGE prediction rows are not retained
unsupported_baseline_metrics.AUROC: N/A: raw EnzymeCAGE prediction rows are not retained
unsupported_baseline_metrics.NDCG@10: N/A: raw EnzymeCAGE prediction rows are not retained

hard_slices: low train-reaction similarity when compatible support exists

r2e_sequence_reaction.scenario: sequence plus reaction representation, structure not required
r2e_sequence_reaction.baseline_variant: official EnzGFM-1.5B encoder family with the paper-defined bidirectional retrieval architecture/native ReactZyme protocol
r2e_sequence_reaction.support_scope: Exact native ReactZyme support for direct paper comparison. Official 1.5B encoder assets are published; the author retrieval-head checkpoint/training script is not. Paper-reported matching native metrics remain the authoritative external comparison; any local head is explicitly an independent author-architecture reproduction.
forbidden_adaptation: extra training labels beyond author protocol

internal_safety_floor.name: Catalyst cleanroom EnzGFM-650M dual-tower expert
internal_safety_floor.role: internal regression floor only; its Catalyst-trained retrieval tower is not the author EnzGFM baseline; local EnzGFM-650M encoder assets are a reproducibility/backstop scale, not the unique strongest external baseline

unsupported_baseline_metrics.MRR: N/A for direct paper delta: Supplementary Table S6 does not report MRR.
unsupported_baseline_metrics.Hit@10: N/A for direct paper delta: Supplementary Table S6 does not provide an exact Top10 value.
unsupported_baseline_metrics.NDCG@10: N/A for direct paper delta: Supplementary Table S6 reports NDCG@1 and NDCG@5; do not substitute another cutoff.

r2e_sequence_reaction.native_split_boundary: Byte-identical official ReactZyme enzyme_smi_split: every one of the 1,573 native test reactions is train-seen; the public archive also contains three exact train/test protein sequences. Treat it as sequence-divergent known-reaction retrieval, not reaction-novel discovery.
